title: Bot management

notFound.title: Bot not found
notFound.body: This bot has no Lineup profile. Add it first from the dashboard.

forbidden.title: You do not manage this bot
forbidden.body: You must own or administer the bot's support server. "Manage Server" is not enough. If the developer just changed the support server, the rights follow the new one at the next refresh.

profile.description: What people see when they look at the bot.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.label: Show the bot in the directory
visibility.on: The bot's profile and posts are visible to everyone.
visibility.off: The profile and its posts are hidden, except for managers and the Moddy staff.
visibility.description: Who can see the bot's profile and posts.

snapshot.title: Discord data
snapshot.body: Name, avatar, server count and support server come from Discord. They are read every 6 hours; you can force a new read once a minute, for example after a change in the Developer Portal.
snapshot.staleDone: Discord did not answer: the previous data is kept.
snapshot.rights: The managers are the administrators of the support server. If it changes, the rights follow the new one after the refresh.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting the profile hides it and closes the bot's posts. The bot itself is not touched on Discord.
danger.effectPosts: Your posts will be closed: drafts and published posts become "closed".
danger.effectHidden: Posts hidden by the Moddy team stay hidden.
danger.effectReclaim: The description, links, tags and visibility are lost.

pages.profile: Description, theme, tags, languages and links.
pages.posts: The posts of this bot, whoever wrote them.

notDiscoverable: Your bot is no longer discoverable on Discord, or no longer has a support server. The data shown is the last known. Turn on discoverability in the Developer Portal (App Directory).
